reconstruction.objective: horizon-weighted free-running latent MSE + 0.1 * context-normalized teacher-score SmoothL1

screening.selection_rule: smallest K passing every frozen Stage A gate

timing.boundary: cached latent to selected elite indices: rollout, official cost, sorting/gathering and teacher verification; exclude encoder and environment

claim_boundary: Stage A fixed-candidate teacher-screening evidence only; reconstructed checkpoint is not the original saved Phase 6 checkpoint; no adaptive CEM or closed-loop claim is produced.
